catalysts.detail_en: Net liquidity (WALCL − RRP − TGA) rising (+$65B/20d) — Treasury spent down $174B since Jun 30 (cash flows into system).
catalysts.detail_zh: 净流动性（WALCL − RRP − TGA）上升（+650亿美元/20日）— 财政部自6月30日起动用现金账户1745亿美元（资金流入系统）。
catalysts.salience_en: When liquidity is expanding like this, buying dips has historically worked ~6pp more often over the next month (a measured odds edge, not a promise).
catalysts.salience_zh: 历史上，在流动性扩张期间逢低买入的成功率比平均高约6个百分点（次月维度）——这是一个经过回测的概率优势，不是承诺。

recovery.headline_zh: 风险回落 — 流动性转向支持
recovery.sub_zh: 回撤概率 19% → 13%（10 日前见顶）。
recovery.do_en: The risk-off may be nearing its end. Begin scaling exposure back in tranches — keep stops, let price confirm the low. Don't chase the first bounce.
recovery.do_zh: 避险或已接近尾声。可分批逐步回补敞口 — 保留止损，待价格确认低点，切勿追逐首次反弹。
recovery.caveat_en: Illustrative context, not a buy trigger. It reads the radar's own intensity trajectory (leak-free) plus the display-only central-bank liquidity series; unlike the alert legs it is not forward-tested yet, and risk can re-accelerate. The de-risk → re-risk response is sizing, scaled in deliberately. BoJ enters only via the aggregate global central-bank tide (no isolated BoJ feed).
recovery.caveat_zh: 仅为示意性背景，并非买入信号。它读取雷达自身的强度轨迹（无未来函数）以及仅供展示的央行流动性序列；不同于警报腿，此读数尚未经前瞻检验，风险可能再度加速。降险→回补的应对是仓位管理、分批进行。日本央行仅通过全球央行总潮汐体现（无独立日本数据源）。

risk_radar_reliability.standing_law: risk_radar_reliability is DISPLAY/CONTEXT ONLY. Rates are graded forward-ledger history (deterministic math over committed rows). Nothing here may gate, rank, size, or escalate any alert or position. Use 'hit rate' and 'track record' in user-facing copy (CI-guards bar the v-word).
